<div class="card-body">
'''Responsibility Of Command''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">司令官の責任</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費して反乱軍基地の戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所上に配備する。没収値＞4の反乱軍か相手のリーダーを目標とする。相手は目標のいる場所では、戦闘を宣言できずフォース消耗も行なえない。目標がウーティーニー・エフェクトに到達したならウーティーニー・エフェクトはキャンセルされる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Responsibility-Of-Command-PSA-82917272.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「本部所属の者は、司令センターに報告を行なえ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Responsibility Of Command.

'''Card text:'''
Spend 2 Force to deploy to the strategy room or battle command post of a Rebel base. Target a Rebel with forfeit greater than 4 or one of the opponent’s leaders. The opponent cannot initiate a battle or Force drain where the target is. Cancel the Effect when the target reaches it.

'''Lore:'''
“Headquarters personnel, report to the command center.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses the paired terms 戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Responsibility Of Command]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
